benchmark: Emotion Aware Voice Assistant / SOVA-Bench-compatible LibriSpeech ASR sample
model_id: Emotion Aware Voice Assistant (configured backend STT)
component_measured: speech recognition only; no LLM response generation, emotion scoring, or TTS
stt_provider_model: Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo (confirmed in backend adapter source)
dataset: LibriSpeech official dev-clean, dev-other, test-clean, test-other local release
sampling: fixed-seed stratified random sample, 250 utterances from each split

corpus_wer.aggregation: corpus/micro WER = sum(S+D+I) / sum(reference words); macro WER is also reported separately

formulas.WER: 100 * (S + D + I) / N_reference_words; corpus/micro aggregation sums counts before division
formulas.latency: wall-clock seconds for one HTTP transcription request, successful requests only

limitations: This is a 1,000-clip stratified sample, not the complete 11,126-clip four-split set.
LibriSpeech ASR WER does not evaluate SOVA-Bench emotion, age, gender, knowledge, semantic/acoustic generation, or end-to-end dialogue tasks.
Results describe the configured service at run time; provider/model identity should be corroborated from backend diagnostics before publication.
Failures remain in coverage and are excluded from WER; report both metrics together.
